lines.text: Video editing has been reinvented three times. Right now, it's happening again.
First, film. Editors cut the actual strip by hand, and spliced the pieces back together.
Then, tape. Video lived on magnetic tape, and editing meant copying shots from one machine to another, in order.
Then, the timeline. Computers turned clips into blocks you could drag, trim, and undo.
And now, the prompt. You describe the edit in words, and AI builds it.
Every step made editing faster, and opened it up to more people.
Film. Tape. Timeline. Text. The tools keep changing. The goal never does. Tell a better story.
